data.title: KuPS vs Trabzonspor Tips - Conference League
data.content:
Trabzonspor (4-2-3-1) Andre Onana; Wagner Pina, Stefan Savic, Samet Akaydin, Mustafa Eskihellac; Ozan Tufan, Celil Yuksel; Aral Simsir, Samed Onur, Emre Kilinc; Franculino Dju  
  
Chibuike Nwaiwu and Sidny Lopes Cabral serve suspensions, while Onuralp Cevikkan, Ruslan Malinovskyi, Umut Nayir, Okay Yokuslu, and Tim Jabol-Folcarelli remain sidelined. Star players Mohamed Salah, Ernest Muci and Fabinho are likely to start on bench.

## Verdict [...] Share this article

 Trabzonspor's weakest link this season is defending
 We are backing both them and KuPS to find the net
 Check our full preview for KuPS vs Trabzonspor below

KuPS vs Trabzonspor Tips 

Trabzonspor have just one clean sheet on the road this season (Getty)

Trabzonspor are the stronger team, but I suspect they might rotate heavily to preserve fitness for upcoming derby against Besiktas. KuPS scored at home regularly, so BTTS is the standout option here. [...] Even though he had just one day to prepare, Trabzonspor looked incredible in Reis' debut, crushing Galatasaray 4-0 in front of the home crowd. Star player Mohamed Salah scored hat-trick and provided one assist in this derby.

They made it two in a row last weekend, crushing Samsunspor 3-0 as visitors, scoring all three goals in the first half. Ernest Muci, Chibuike Nwaiwu and Franculino appeared on the scoresheet.
